topic.title: Standalone Reference MCP Web Client (mcp-client)
topic.shortdesc: User guide for running the standalone reference chatbot client for the MCP Server using containerized deployment.

section.title: Overview
section.p: The mcp-client service provides a standalone reference web chatbot interface on port 3200. It connects to mcp-server via Streamable HTTP transport to execute Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls and render MCP-UI topic component previews.

section.title: Container Deployment
section.p: Run the standalone chatbot client using a single Docker container command:
Open your web browser to http://localhost:3200.

plentry.pd: HTTP port for the web chatbot server (default: 3200).
Streamable HTTP endpoint of the connected MCP server (default: http://localhost:4001/mcp).
Active LLM provider (gemini, anthropic, openai, ollama).
Set to true to display MCP tool call parameters and execution details in chat responses.
